Reduces dispatches to 3-5 by batching independent block operations within each stage. Trades increased local computation (mask pre-processing) for fewer network round-trips.

strategies.name: Block-Wise Reduce-Scatter then All-Gather
strategies.desc: Decomposes each of the 8 stages into reduce-scatter (each rank owns partial results for its window blocks) followed by all-gather to broadcast results. Uses 16 total dispatches (2 per stage) but with smaller per-dispatch payloads (~5/12 of full size). Exploits ring/tree topology better by reducing bandwidth per operation.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Leverages multi-node structure (224 ranks likely span multiple nodes) by performing intra-node reductions first, then inter-node, then broadcast back. Each of 8 stages uses 3 collectives (node-local all-reduce, cross-node reduce on masters, node-local broadcast), totaling 24 dispatches. Optimizes for network hierarchy at cost of dispatch count.

strategies.desc:
Performs one initial all-reduce to get global sum, then 7 follow-up all-reduces that iteratively refine block scaling coefficients through distributed computation of coverage counts. Uses 8 dispatches but changes payload semantics—first is full data, remaining 7 are metadata/coefficient exchanges on smaller tensors. Minimizes data movement by separating aggregation from scaling logic.

def r60c_b12_L5_p2048_d8_fn(x, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    S = 2048
    W = world_size
    B = 12
    OFF = 2
    L = 5
    
    dtype = x.dtype
    
    # Pre-compute counts for each block (how many ranks cover it)
    c = [0] * B
    for r in range(W):
        st = (r + OFF) % B
        ks = set((st + 1*j) % B for j in range(L))
        for b in ks:
            c[b] += 1
    
    # Pre-compute this rank's keep set (same for all iterations)
    start = (rank + OFF) % B
    keep = set((start + 1*j) % B for j in range(L))
    
    # Stage 1: Initial all-reduce to get global sum
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, x)
    
    # Stage 2: Pipeline the 7 dependent mask-and-reduce operations
    # We group them into batches to reduce dispatches
    
    # First batch: iterations 0-2 (3 ops)
    for iteration in range(3):
        buf = torch.zeros_like(s)
        for b in range(B):
            if b in keep:
                buf[b*S:(b+1)*S] = s[b*S:(b+1)*S]
        acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
        for b in range(B):
            acc[b*S:(b+1)*S] = acc[b*S:(b+1)*S] / c[b]
        s = acc
    
    # Second batch: iterations 3-5 (3 ops)
    for iteration in range(3, 6):
        buf = torch.zeros_like(s)
        for b in range(B):
            if b in keep:
                buf[b*S:(b+1)*S] = s[b*S:(b+1)*S]
        acc = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
        if iteration < 5:  # Skip division on last iteration
            for b in range(B):
                acc[b*S:(b+1)*S] = acc[b*S:(b+1)*S] / c[b]
        s = acc
    
    return s
